objective.text: Invalidate session data and regenerate the CSRF token when logging out.

difficulty.rationale: End authentication and clear session state at the logout boundary.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Logout must end the authenticated session, clear its application data, change its identifier, and establish a fresh CSRF token. Which sequence implements the documented session cleanup after Auth::logout()?

options.rationale: Ordinary regeneration retains application session data, contrary to the cleanup requirement.
options.misconception: Ordinary regeneration retains application session data, contrary to the cleanup requirement.

options.rationale: invalidate clears data and migrates the ID; regenerateToken supplies a new token for subsequent requests.
Flushing removes attributes but does not by itself migrate the identifier and establish the requested fresh token.
options.misconception: Flushing removes attributes but does not by itself migrate the identifier and establish the requested fresh token.

options.rationale: A new token alone neither clears application session data nor rotates the session identifier.
options.misconception: A new token alone neither clears application session data nor rotates the session identifier.
